To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a novel Etest strip for glycopeptide resistance detection, E-VA/TEIC 32, was developed for clinical and epidemiological purposes.
we have developed a new Etest glycopeptide-intermediate S. aureus strip that is easy to use, has a high specificity and sensitivity, and is able to detect glycopeptide-intermediates in a short time.

a new Etest strip (E- VA/TP) with a gradient of VA (0.5 to 8 μg/ml) on one side and TP (0.5 μg/ml) with a gradient (0.5/1/2/4/8 μg/ml), with a second prototype overlaid with nutrient to enhance hGISA growth, was evaluated for the detection of glycopeptide-intermediate S. aureus strains.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the detection and identification of glycopeptide-intermediate strains of Staphylococci.
the development and testing of a new Etest strip that can be used to detect GISA in clinical laboratories.
the development and evaluation of a new Etest vancomyicin-teicoplanin strip for detection of hVISA, in particular, heterogenous GISA.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Etest GRD (E-VA-TP+S) strip is a promising new method for the detection of hGisa in the laboratory.
E-VA-TP+S is an acceptable method for detection of GISA and hGISA, but it needs to be evaluated in a large clinical study.

the new Etest VA 32-TP 32 (E-VA32/TP32) double-sided gradient strips with the prototype E-VA/ TP+S strip overlaid on the top of the E-VA/32/TP32 strip, with a 48-h reading, is the most accurate method for detection of GISA, particularly hGISA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Etest GRD method is an excellent screening tool for hGISA and GISA detection in clinical laboratories.

E-VA-TP+S is a new Etest glycopeptide resistance detection strip that has high specificity and sensitivity for detection of GISA and hGISA strains and that is easy and practical to use in clinical microbiology laboratories.
E-VA-TP+S is a simple, easy-to-use, and accurate method for detection of h-GISA/GISA.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Etest GRD can be a useful method for detection of GISA and hGISA, especially when the results can be read at 48 h.
the Etest GRD is an easy and practical tool to detect hGISA/GISAs, which is important for surveillance purposes and for monitoring of hGISA in the community.
the E-VA/32-TP/32+S is a promising tool for the detection of GISA and in particular hGISA.
